steps.caption: Tap New game, then choose Draw 1 (easier) or Draw 3 (harder)
steps.shows: The New game card over the board: Draw 1 (selected), Draw 3, Cancel

steps.caption: A fresh deal: seven columns, the stock top left, four foundations top right
steps.shows: New Draw 1 deal, 0 moves, stock 24, seven columns with the top cards face up

steps.caption: Tap a card: if it fits only one column, it goes there by itself
steps.shows: Jack of spades moved onto the queen of hearts; the jack of clubs underneath turned face up; 1 move

steps.caption: Tap the stock to turn a card onto the waste
steps.shows: Stock 23, the ace of hearts turned onto the waste; 2 moves

steps.caption: Tap an ace and it goes up to its foundation
steps.shows: Ace of hearts on the first foundation; 3 moves

steps.caption: A card that fits more than one place is picked up and drawn black
steps.shows: Another deal (11 moves): the 2 of spades on the waste is drawn black; it fits on the 3 of hearts or the 3 of diamonds

steps.caption: Then tap where it goes
steps.shows: The 2 of spades placed on the 3 of hearts in the third column; 12 moves

steps.caption: Undo takes back a move at a time
steps.shows: The 2 of spades back on the waste; 11 moves

steps.caption: When no move can get anywhere, it says No moves left: Undo, or start a new game
steps.shows: A later deal (63 moves) stuck: 'No moves left' in place of the move count, New game drawn filled

steps.caption: Win, and the board says how many moves it took; deal again from the card
steps.shows: 'You won! In 131 moves. Your best yet!' with Draw 1 / Draw 3 buttons; all four kings on the foundations

steps.caption: Draw 3: the stock turns three cards at a time, and only the top one plays
steps.shows: Draw 3 deal after one stock tap: three cards fanned on the waste (4, 9, 9 of clubs on top); 1 move
